description: Makes a series for the project, as a draft: nothing is made, spent or posted until series_start. Marsell can run a series in the owner's own voice, made and posted every day from the day's news on a topic (for example daily archaeology news): each day it searches the news on the topic, drops what the series already reported, picks the best new story and makes a cited Short about it, narrated in a voice the project kept (the owner's own clone: voice_clone); a day with no new story gets no episode. For that, give kind video, a topic (what the news is about: "archaeology: new finds, digs and research"), cadence daily, and narrator_voice: the voiceId of a voice the project kept (voices_read lists them; voice_clone makes the owner's own). Without a topic Marsell plans the series a season at a time in Marsell. A video series starts with two video types, a Short and a long film; each is the owner's to shape after it is made with series_video_type_set (motion graphics in code, AI video, stills or a mix; any length from 5 seconds; the shape in the owner's words; narrated or no voice; music; how many a week), which says what an episode then costs. Before creating or starting one, quote the month with series_quote and tell the owner the tokens each episode and the month may use, whether their plan holds it, and what it costs them in dollars a month (costs_the_owner: the price of the plan that holds it). Free.

about.description: What it is about and who it is for, in the owner's words.

cadence.description: How often it comes out. Or per_week.

format.description: A video series' video type: original-short (the default) or original-long.

kind.description: video (the default), pictures or newsletter. A series from the news is a video series.

narrator_voice.description: A video series' narrator: the voiceId of one of the project's kept voices (voices_read).

notes.description: With a topic: what the owner wants from the stories (what to lean on, what to leave out).

per_week.description: Episodes a week, 0 to 21 (7 is every day). Instead of cadence.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

time.description: The time it comes out, HH:MM (18:00 when left out).

timezone.description: The owner's time zone, IANA: "Europe/Berlin" (UTC when left out).

topic.description: Makes it a series from the day's news on this topic.

name: series_create
title: Make a series
